scientific_question: DATA_DISTRIBUTION_GENERALIZATION: with model scale / architecture / tokenizer / training objective / AdamW / clipping / token budget / response protocol held fixed, does the full tangent C still predict the finite-difference response and systematically beat optimizer-only B at H>1 when only the pretraining corpus changes (D0 -> D1)?
data_only_principle: Everything is bit-identical to the frozen G1a 26M configuration except the pretraining corpus: same model (26,681,728 unique params), same tokenizer, same seq len, same PretrainDataset causal-LM pipeline (BOS/EOS, truncation to 126+2, padding mask), same AdamW family/hyperparameters, same clip=1.0, same bf16 semantics, same global batch (8 seqs x 128 tokens = 1024 tokens/optimizer-step), same LR schedule axis (256 micro-steps), same 128 planned optimizer steps, same state grid (26/64/102), same q/E1/E2/stream-seed derivation, same H official grid {1,4,8}. D1 pool size = D0 pool size = 4096 records; partition sizes identical (32 probe / 128 eval / 3936 train).

d0_reference.role: frozen G1a 26M D0 condition; read directly for comparison; NEVER rerun

d1_selection.priority_rule: B2: primary D1 = MiniMind pretrain_hq.jsonl; not present locally and not in current HEAD of the official HF dataset repo, but present at the pre-deletion official revision 3a9bbe611244811e45b96661a84047f112c8ed01 (uploaded 2026-01-17, deleted from HEAD 2026-03-26) of jingyaogong/minimind_dataset; downloaded to the versioned data dir below; selected BEFORE any G2 response result was opened; no alternative corpus was compared on results
d1_selection.schema: {"text": <string>} (identical to D0; no adapter needed; zero content filtering)
d1_selection.tokenizer_compatibility: same frozen minimind tokenizer (vocab 6400); verified by token-statistics sample in dataset_manifest.json before training

d1_pool_and_partition.pool_rule: first 4096 indices of make_permutation(source_records, 60202601), sorted ascending; same size as D0 pool; frozen before training
d1_pool_and_partition.partition_rule: build_partition(4096, seed=60202603, probe_size=32, eval_size=128) - identical sizes to v07/G1a partition
d1_pool_and_partition.no_content_selection: no quality filtering, no language-ratio balancing, no D0 mixing, no sample picking by content; corpus order comes solely from the frozen permutation seed

model.intermediate_size_rule: MiniMindConfig default ceil(hidden*pi/64)*64 (same frozen formula as anchor; NOT hand-picked)

training.seed_note: same seeds as G1a for matched random-init/data-order derivation; because the corpus differs, D0 vs D1 is NOT a sample-paired experiment
training.optimizer: torch.optim.AdamW default family: betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0.01
training.train_batch_seed_rule: train_seed + 1704 (same frozen derivation rule as v07/G1a)
training.state_step_rule: round(fraction * 128): 20%->26, 50%->64, 80%->102 (identical to G1a, verified against G1a training_manifest)
training.checkpoint_contents: same as G1a (model state, AdamW m/v/step, scaler state, full RNG state, global step, metadata incl. dataset/pool hashes)

q_construction.rule: identical to v07/G1a: per state, probe batch = all 32 partition probe_indices in one batch, probe loss backward, q = g_probe / ||g_probe|| (global L2); probe/eval permanently excluded from trajectory

response_protocol_inheritance.pulse: post-unscale / pre-clip, first optimizer step only, +/-epsilon*q
response_protocol_inheritance.epsilon_rule: epsilon = 0.25 * sigma_q, sigma_q = std(ddof=1) of s over 16 E1 streams (frozen rule, unchanged)
response_protocol_inheritance.crn: baseline/plus/minus share identical Z_t, batch manifest, RNG stream, LR path
response_protocol_inheritance.future_lr: set_native_micro_lr along the same 256-micro-step cosine axis
response_protocol_inheritance.stream_seed_rule: two_level_seed with the SAME E1/E2 base seeds as G1a (408202601/409202601) - identical index streams over the D1 corpus for matched descriptive comparison
response_protocol_inheritance.hvp: math-SDPA reverse-over-reverse surrogate (same frozen mixed-backend caveat)

main_matrix.cells: 27 state-horizon cells; 36 baseline future streams; future_stream_manifest.json frozen before any E2 response branch

mechanism_subset.purpose: mechanism-transfer diagnostic under corpus shift; NOT a necessary condition for STRONG_DATA_REPLICATION

gains.calibers: BOTH reported and never mixed: (a) stream-first aggregation identical to G1a report section 7; (b) official-cell diagnostic identical to the main-matrix aggregation

checks: q strictly same names/shapes as parameters
H=1 analytic B vs FD consistency
train-loader deterministic replay (double derivation equality) and dataset/pool/partition hash match
smoke_gate.policy: implementation bugs may be fixed and re-smoked with a change log; scientific-definition problems => CONTRACT_INCOMPATIBLE, stop and report

statistics.aggregation_source: strict reuse of the frozen G1a/G1b main aggregation: fr.g1a_26m_scale_generalization_v01.cell_relative_errors + aggregate_metrics (which import the frozen a0c _metric / relative_error); NO third error caliber is invented
statistics.bootstrap: cluster-aware bootstrap seed -> stage -> cell over D1 H>1 official cells, paired B/C, 20000 resamples, rng 20260916; report mean paired improvement, 95% percentile interval, and the fraction of resamples with improvement > 0 (never called a p-value or posterior probability); 3 seeds => exploratory uncertainty, streams are not independent runs

verdict_thresholds_frozen.analysis_grid: 9 states x H in {1,4,8} = 27 rows; H=1 rows are structural ties (B==C) and are excluded from paired win/loss counts but included in pooled R2/MAE

STRONG_DATA_REPLICATION.condition_1: C pooled R2 over the 27 official rows >= 0.90
STRONG_DATA_REPLICATION.condition_2: among the 18 H>1 rows, at least 80% (>=15 of 18) have err_C < err_B; tie defined as |err_C - err_B| <= 1e-12
STRONG_DATA_REPLICATION.condition_3: H=8 (9 rows): paired mean err_C < mean err_B AND C R2 at H=8 >= 0.50 AND corr at H=8 > 0
STRONG_DATA_REPLICATION.condition_4: at least 2 of 3 seeds have mean(err_B - err_C) > 0 over that seed's H>1 rows

verdict_thresholds_frozen.PARTIAL_DATA_REPLICATION: pooled H>1 mean relative error of C < that of B, but not all STRONG conditions hold (including heterogeneous seeds/stages)
verdict_thresholds_frozen.NO_DATA_REPLICATION: C is not overall better than B, or C lost predictive validity vs FD
verdict_thresholds_frozen.RESOURCE_LIMIT: resources prevent completion; no silent downscale
verdict_thresholds_frozen.CONTRACT_INCOMPATIBLE: D1 cannot enter the protocol without changing core scientific definitions
verdict_thresholds_frozen.note: thresholds frozen here before any result is opened; will not be changed based on results

dynamics_context.usage: explanation only; states may NOT be filtered post hoc using these variables

resource_rules.gpu: share politely; never kill external workloads; GPU1 untouched
forbidden: changing seq len / global batch / clip / optimizer / precision semantics / horizons
resource_rules.resource_limit_policy: emit RESOURCE_LIMIT with diagnostics; do NOT silently downscale
